'''Kafane''' was a poor [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Kafane system/Legends|Kafane system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> Kafane was connected to the worlds of [[Nimia]] and [[Ulmatra/Legends|Ulmatra]] by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called [[the Dead Road]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kafane was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[2009]], which placed the planet in grid square S-9.<ref name="TEA" />
